ticket_text: Hi, I just published my first chatbot app and I want to call it from my own backend. Where do I get an API key for it? -- Marcus
assistant_answer: Hi Marcus, congrats on publishing your first app! You can get the key from inside that app: open the app in Studio, go to API Access (sometimes labeled Monitoring > API Key), and click 'Create new Secret Key.' Copy it right away since Dify only shows it once -- the key is prefixed app- and you'll use it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header when calling the app's API. Note that this key only works for this specific app; if you publish a second app later you'll need to generate a separate key for it.
